title: Goodbye joint replacements? Stanford scientists found a way to regrow cartilage and stop arthritis
caption:
Stanford researchers have discovered a way to potentially regrow knee cartilage. By blocking a specific protein that accumulates with age, they helped cells return to a youthful, regenerative state. It's a promising step toward treating osteoarthritis without surgery.

Source: Sciencedaily - Goodbye joint replacements? Stanford scientists found a way to regrow cartilage and stop arthritis
